title: A Heaven Symbol Master
summary: Lin Dong smashes the statue and takes the real Ancient Secret Key, while the Demon Rock Dynasty captures Mo Ling outside. The key carries Lin Dong into a separate space, where Mu Hongling reveals her hidden strength and admits she used him. She subdues the Blood Spirit Puppet and Little Flame and takes the key, but the key sends her away. Lin Dong then refines the Heavenly Symbol Spirit Tree, and the remnant soul of the key's former owner tries to take his body. Little Mink tears it apart with devouring power, and Lin Dong becomes a Heaven Symbol Master. Little Mink reminds him of his promise to help restore Little Mink's true body.
